beautyTipsArticle.introduction: Beauty is not just about looking good. It's about feeling confident and expressing your unique style. With the right care and mindful choices, you can keep your jewellery shining for years. In this article, we're sharing simple yet effective tips that will help you maintain the beauty and brilliance of your favourite pieces.

image.alt: Elegant jewellery styling with delicate gemstone rings

beautyTipsArticle.quotation: Jewellery adds a touch of elegance to every moment. With the right care and styling, you can keep your favourite pieces looking beautiful for years to come. These simple tips will help you maintain their shine, protect their quality and make them a long-lasting part of your collection.

tips.title: Keep Your Jewellery Clean
paragraphs: Regular cleaning helps maintain the natural shine of your jewellery. Use a soft, lint-free cloth to gently wipe your pieces after wearing them. For a deeper clean, use a mild jewellery cleaner or lukewarm water with a few drops of gentle soap. Avoid harsh chemicals that can damage delicate stones and metals.

tips.title: Store Them Properly
paragraphs: Always store your jewellery in a soft-lined jewellery box or individual pouches to prevent scratches and tangling. Keep different pieces separate, especially those with gemstones or delicate designs. Proper storage not only keeps them safe but also helps maintain their brilliance for longer.

tips.title: Avoid Exposure to Harsh Elements
paragraphs: Remove your jewellery before swimming, exercising or using household cleaning products. Exposure to chlorine, sweat, perfumes and harsh chemicals can dull the shine and damage the metal or gemstones. Putting them on after your skincare and makeup routine is a good habit.

tips.title: Get Professional Check-ups
paragraphs: For valuable or frequently worn pieces, it's a good idea to get them checked by a professional jeweller once in a while. They can inspect the settings, clean them thoroughly and ensure that your jewellery remains in perfect condition.

Following these simple tips will help you keep your jewellery as beautiful as the day you bought it. A little care goes a long way in preserving the shine, quality and sentimental value of your favourite pieces, so you can enjoy them for many years to come.

section.description: Find answers to common questions about our jewellery, orders, payment, care tips and more.

items.question: How do I know if my order is confirmed?
items.answer: Once your order is successfully placed, you will receive an order confirmation email or message containing your order number and purchase details. If you cannot find it, please check your spam folder or contact our support team.

items.question: Can I change my shipping address after my order is placed?
items.answer: If your order has not been dispatched, you may be able to update your shipping address. Please contact our customer support team as soon as possible with your order number. Changes cannot always be guaranteed after processing begins.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Available payment methods may include credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking and other options displayed at checkout. Please check the payment page for the methods currently supported by our store.

items.question: Do you offer international shipping?
items.answer: International shipping availability depends on the destination. Please contact our team or check the shipping information on our website to confirm delivery options, shipping charges and applicable customs duties for your location.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Delivery times depend on your location, product availability and order processing. Your estimated delivery date and tracking details will be shared when available. Custom-made jewellery may require additional preparation time.

items.question: Can I return or exchange a product?
items.answer: Eligible products may be returned or exchanged according to our store's return policy. Please review the applicable time limits, product condition requirements and exclusions before requesting a return or exchange.

items.question: How do I care for my jewellery?
items.answer: Store your jewellery separately in a soft-lined box, avoid direct contact with perfumes and harsh chemicals, and clean it gently with a soft cloth. Professional cleaning is recommended when appropriate for the jewellery and gemstones.

items.question: Is your jewellery certified and authentic?
items.answer: We aim to provide authentic jewellery with accurate product information. Where applicable, certification details for diamonds, gemstones and precious metals should be listed on the product page or supplied with the item.

items.question: Do you provide custom or personalised jewellery?
items.answer: Customisation options may include personalised designs, engraving and selected gemstone or metal choices. Contact our team with your preferred design and requirements to discuss available options, pricing and production timelines.
